description: isUtf8Text (src/ai/docsHost.ts) and is_utf8_text (packages/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/docs/rules.rs): bytes as hex; text is whether the file is indexed. Reason text for a refusal: 'not UTF-8 text'.

cases.name: UTF-8 with a byte order mark
UTF-16 LE with a byte order mark
UTF-16 BE with a byte order mark
UTF-32 LE with a byte order mark
UTF-32 BE with a byte order mark
UTF-16 LE without a byte order mark
a NUL byte in the middle
a NUL byte at the end
a lone FF byte is not a byte order mark
invalid UTF-8 without NUL is still text (decoded lossily)
